fixed_management: Four 15-percent tranches and a 40-percent SMA60/ATR runner with a banked-profit floor.
metric_correction: Profit giveback is measured only from favourable excursion observed before exit or from a completed close that actually armed the runner. Post-exit horizon MFE is a counterfactual missed-opportunity metric and cannot label realised giveback.
primary_metrics: banked tranche then final net non-positive
completed-close runner arm then final net non-positive
mean and robust net basis points
